name: Missing Authorization Header
description: Tests if the endpoint enforces authentication when the Authorization header is completely absent.
expected_indicator: HTTP 200 OK or 201 Created instead of HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

name: Expired JWT Timestamp
description: Tests if the system validates the 'exp' claim by sending a syntactically valid but expired JWT (exp claim set to Unix timestamp 1000).
expected_indicator: The system processes the request successfully instead of rejecting the expired token.

name: JWT None Algorithm
description: Tests if the authentication parser accepts JWTs with the algorithm field set to 'none' and an empty signature.
expected_indicator: The system accepts the unsigned JWT and authenticates the user.

name: Malformed Truncated Bearer Token
description: Tests for improper error handling or fallback behavior when given a malformed Bearer token (truncated mid-string).
expected_indicator: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error or crash instead of graceful HTTP 401/400.

name: Rate Limit Evasion via X-Forwarded-For
description: Tests if rate limiting can be evaded by a rapid repeated request with X-Forwarded-For header set to 127.0.0.1.
expected_indicator: Request succeeds despite rate limit threshold, or bypasses IP blocklist.

name: Spoofed X-Real-IP Private Subnet
description: Tests if the rate limiter trusts a request with X-Real-IP spoofed to a private subnet address.
expected_indicator: Rate limit is not enforced, treating the request as originating from a trusted internal source.

name: Conflicting Client IP Headers
description: Sends a request with both X-Forwarded-For and X-Original-IP set to conflicting values to confuse the rate limiter.
expected_indicator: Rate limit counters fail to increment correctly, allowing excess requests.

name: Negative Numeric Boundary
description: Sends a numeric field set to -99999 to test for integer underflow or logic bypass.
expected_indicator: Transaction succeeds with a negative value, modifying account balance erroneously.

name: SQL Injection Fragment
description: Injects a string field containing a SQL fragment ("' OR 1=1 --") to bypass authentication or filter criteria.
expected_indicator: The response returns all database records instead of a filtered subset.

name: Oversized String Payload
description: Sends a string field with a 500-character repeated payload to test size limits.
expected_indicator: HTTP 500, application crash, or excessive response delay indicating resource exhaustion.

name: Type Confusion Integer as String
description: Sends a field as an integer where a string is expected (type confusion) to test parser type safety.
expected_indicator: Stack trace exposed in response or application crash due to unhandled TypeError.

name: Mass Assignment Extra Field
description: Injects an extra undocumented field alongside valid fields (mass assignment probe).
expected_indicator: The response shows the account was created or updated with administrative privileges.

name: Deeply Nested Object DoS
description: Sends a deeply nested object (10 levels) where a scalar string is expected.
expected_indicator: Application crash, out of memory error, or unhandled exception stack trace.

name: Unicode Normalization Bypass
description: Sends a string field containing a unicode normalization attack (café vs cafe\u0301 comparison bypass).
expected_indicator: The system grants access or allows registration of a visually identical restricted username.

name: Duplicate Key SQL Injection
description: Sends a JSON body with a duplicate key where the second value is a SQL fragment.
expected_indicator: The system bypasses validation on the first key but executes the second key in the database.
